title: JBoss QuickStarts must be removed.
check_content: Examine the <JBOSS_HOME> folder.  If a jboss-eap-6.3.0-GA-quickstarts folder exits, this is a finding.
VulnDiscussion: JBoss QuickStarts are demo applications that can be deployed quickly.  Demo applications are not written with security in mind and often open new attack vectors.  QuickStarts must be removed.
